description: We are Space Punks, a team driven by curiosity, creativity, and a passion for space exploration. Our project, Moon and Mars Analog, brings planetary exploration to life through an immersive 3D simulation, showcasing the landscapes, landmarks, and unique environments of the Moon and Mars. We aim to make space science more interactive, accessible, and exciting while inspiring the next generation of explorers.
summary:
Team Space Punks – AstroDashboard 🚀

AstroDashboard is an interactive platform for exploring Earth, the Moon, and Mars. It combines 3D celestial simulations, planetary data, and AI-powered insights to make space science easier to see and understand.

Explore planetary surfaces, visit Apollo landing sites and lunar craters, compare Earth locations with lunar terrain, and watch orbital motion in action. The dashboard also features scientific visualizations, celestial radar, simulation controls, and research on Earth environments that resemble extraterrestrial landscapes.

Built with React, Three.js, React Three Fiber, and Recharts, AstroDashboard uses Google Gemini to explain planetary data and comparisons. An Express.js backend protects API credentials, validates requests, and limits traffic. Firebase, Firestore security rules, and App Check add another layer of protection.

Stack: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js, React Three Fiber, React Three Drei, Recharts, Node.js, Express.js, Gemini API, Firebase, Docker, and Google Cloud Run.

Our goal: Make planetary exploration more accessible, interactive, and fun.
details:
Team Space Punks – Astro Dashboard 🚀

Project Description

:

Astro Dashboard is a full-stack, AI-powered planetary exploration platform designed to make space science interactive through 3D celestial simulations, scientific data visualization, and comparative planetary research.

The platform allows users to explore realistic 3D models of Earth, the Moon, and Mars, investigate lunar landmarks such as Apollo landing sites and craters, and compare geographical features, elevations, and terrain characteristics between Earth and extraterrestrial environments.

Key Features:

  • 3D Planetary Simulation: Interactive exploration of Earth, Moon, and Mars using realistic 3D visualizations.
  • Comparative Planetary Telemetry: Compare elevations, geographical locations, terrain characteristics, and scientific measurements.
  • Orbital Mechanics: Visualize celestial movements and explore orbital physics.
  • Lunar Exploration Database: Discover Apollo landing sites, lunar craters, robotic landers, and other astronomical objects.
  • Planetary Analog Research: Explore Earth's environments that resemble extraterrestrial landscapes.
  • Gemini AI Integration: Generate AI-powered scientific explanations and planetary comparisons.
  • Interactive Dashboard: Visualize scientific telemetry through charts, radar displays, and simulation controls.

Technology Stack: React 19, JavaScript/TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express.js, Google Gemini API, Firebase, Firestore, Docker, and Google Cloud Run,Vite.

Objective: Bridge the gap between complex planetary science and interactive learning by combining 3D simulation, AI, and scientific computing into one unified space exploration platform.

Source: GitHub – Team Space Punks AstroDashboard.
